name: Anan (Tokushima, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Anan city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bud with a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Anan, a city in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 27 June 1988; the emblem dates from 1 October 1958.

features.role: Anan city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised bud with a small ring
